en.summary: Open articles, retain ancestry/sort and history; Chromium
details: dir              Published site directory; default: public
--headed         Show the browser window
--trace          Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>      Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>   Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--from <path>    Published source collection; include the desired sorting fragment
--page <path>    Article pathname linked from the source collection
--widths <list>  Comma-separated viewport widths; test height: 900 pixels; default: 390,1024,1440
--pan <px>       Canvas offset; default: keep the article link visible, pan narrow viewports
--touch          Use native taps in a mobile touch context
--drag <px>      Drag left with real Chromium touch input before opening
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/ --page /article/
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/#sort=name-desc --page /article/ --touch
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/ --page /article/ --widths 390 --touch --drag 160

zh.summary: 打开文章、保留来源排序与历史；Chromium
details: dir              已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed         显示浏览器窗口
--trace          保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>      在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>   浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--from <path>    已构建的来源集合，含目标排序片段
--page <path>    来源集合链接的文章路径
--widths <list>  视口宽度，用逗号分隔；检查高度为 900 像素；默认：390,1024,1440
--pan <px>       画幅偏移，单位为像素；默认：保持文章链接可见，并平移窄视口
--touch          在移动触摸环境中使用原生点按
--drag <px>      打开前用 Chromium 原生触摸向左拖动
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/ --page /article/
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/#sort=name-desc --page /article/ --touch
swban check/browser/canvas/open ./preview --from /all/ --page /article/ --widths 390 --touch --drag 160
